items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: From then on I was a convert and a Stravinsky addict and a classical music addict, as I still am today.

ctx.x: It blew me away and blew my mind. It had nothing to do with jazz. I said, "What is that?" The Rite of Spring. From then on I was a convert and a Stravinsky addict and a classical music addict, as I still am today.
